profile.headline: AI/Gameplay Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the computer games industry. Strong engineering professional skilled in C/C++, Gameplay, 3D math. Exploring and Learning more about challenges in AI and animation systems

positions.title: Senior AI Software Engineer
positions.description:
Owned the Enemy AI Architecture for Crimson Moon https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ul3gAI899IQ

Worked with design to establish the behavior systems that drives enemy behaviors. Created scalable, performant, and easily iterate-able systems for driving enemy combat behavior selection, perception, reactions, variety of debuggers etc.

positions.title: Senior AI Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked with design, production, and animation to setup core AI systems from scratch for a Survival game. Setup various
systems such as Perception, behavior management, combat manager etc. Worked with design and QA to setup debug
features such as various gameplay debuggers, console commands to visualize debug information.
Setup a system for behavior selection that would work with behavior trees out of combat and would go into utility (scoring
based) behavior selection when in combat.
Coordinated with design, production, animation to figure out the needs for AI characters, keeping in mind long term goals
for the game, as well as short term needs for vertical slice.
Mentored another AI engineer, brainstormed tech specs for various AI systems
positions.insights: Skills: Visual Studio · Artificial Intelligence · Unreal Engine 4 · 3d Math · Programming · Game Development · C++ · Gameplay Programming · Game Developers · Game Programming

positions.title: Undergrad research assistant
positions.description:
Successfully scripted a game for a PhD Student as a part of her project. The game consisted of
various mechanics like matching same colored tiles, opening gates on trigger etc. This game was
made in Unity3D using JavaScript for scripting. The game was to be used for research, using
telemetry and eye tracking of users.

projects.title: KiTES
projects.description:
• KiTES aims to reinvent ‘School education’ through immersive and interactive experiences designed for the cutting-edge SMALLab platform.
• Our goal is to design and develop ‘Transformational games’ that reinforces the curricular concepts in various subject areas. 
• We are designing the experiences for the cutting-edge SMALLab platform. 
• SMALLab, (Situated Multimedia Arts Learning Lab) is an embodied learning environment with motion-capture technology that tracks students’ 3D movements as they learn in immersive, interactive space.
• In this dynamic and collaborative environment, students get to interact with the game as a group through touch, sight and sound, thus making the learning experience very much fun, effective and easy-to-grasp.
